title: Shader Basics, Blending & Textures • Shaders for Game Devs [Part 1]
summary: The first part of Freya Holmer's three-part, nearly four-hour lecture on shader coding for game devs in Unity. It covers what shaders are, vertex and fragment shaders, interpolators, data types, blending and textures.
why: Recommended as a good first-steps shader tutorial that also teaches broad graphics knowledge.

quote.text: I liked this tutorial series as a "first steps" by Freya Holmér
